stem: 2/12 old child sees you with a loud cough. Sometimes it gets so bad that they vomit (have done this once). At other times, (twice) they have stopped breathing or turned red, then blue. There is no wheeze. Mother has been sick with the same cough for 1 month prior. Regarding the child’s illness:

options.text: There is no immunization for this
The immunization isn’t fully effective yet
